release_decision: User explicitly requested holding the release until remix is ready. Do not publish the connection-only release.
scope: Optional remix of a user-selected reference, distinct from an original composition inspired by it

release_blockers.required: Persist remix mode, parent reference identity, source authorization, retained/replaced layers and target musical brief. Bind consent to the selected source. Do not inherit another song's approvals or silently substitute inspiration mode.

Current stem imports explicitly disable warping. Add capability-tested clip timing, shared source beat maps, per-source stretch mode, pitch/formant handling where supported, readback and audition. Do not change project BPM and claim the imported stems followed. Preserve originals.

Current record_arrangement refuses occupied arrangements; replacement clears arrangement material. Add stable source/work-track identities, track-scoped edits, source-to-destination section maps, fades/tails and verified boundaries without clearing retained stems.

Persist import progress and source/output manifests across workers and restarts. Identify partial imports and reconcile exact audio file identities, clip offsets, duration and routing before retrying; track-name verification alone is insufficient.

quality_work: Prefer user-supplied original multitracks when available; offer separation as an estimated fallback, with per-stem auditions, bleed/artifact warnings and explicit retention choices.
Confirm tempo, downbeats, meter, key/tuning uncertainty and section boundaries. Use one shared timing map for all stems and retain each source's offsets.
Record intended retained hooks/vocals, new style, target tempo/key, duration, sections, exclusions and source-pack constraints. Ask focused follow-up questions only for unresolved choices.
Build complementary drums, bass and harmonic parts one at a time; do not double full drums with child drum stems or stack a replacement bass over a retained conflicting bass.
Discover actual EQ, sidechain, delay, reverb and automation controls; verify units, routing, envelopes and readback. Effects do not imply recovery of the source track's original processing.
Provide dry/processed and source/remix comparisons at matched levels, with both solo and in-context previews and per-revision approval.

Validate complete export bounds, absence of missing media, clipping, unintended silence, doubled sources and truncated effect tails. Measure integrated loudness and true peak; retain unmastered and final renders.
Keep source files, new project, remix brief, revisions, approvals and action checkpoints separate and recoverable. Package project media without overwriting the user's original.
release_acceptance: Frontend-only flow from selecting Remix this reference through source authorization, layer selection, timing confirmation, saved plan, preview approval, arrangement and export.
Same-tempo and changed-tempo cases with vocals, percussion and sustained material; inspect alignment at start, transitions and end and audition artifacts.
Reconnect, refresh, canceled import and worker restart do not duplicate tracks or lose the saved remix intent.
Original audio hashes and original project remain unchanged; retained layers and rebuilt layers are independently traceable.
Real disposable Ableton set and exported audio verified, not only mocked tools or a successful render response.
separate_connection_release: Bridge 1.3.20 build/signing is in progress. No remix feature or new installer has been published by this work.
